document: Cloudflare Tunnel — Current Batch Audited Chronology
evidence_rule: Only what is visibly established in the supplied screenshot is marked CONFIRMED. Configuration success is not treated as proof of later application reachability.

chronology.result: The screenshot shows Cloudflare tunnel prechecks running for UDP/QUIC, TCP/HTTP2 and Cloudflare API connectivity.
The log shows component=UDP Connectivity with details=QUIC connection successful and status=pass.
The log shows component=TCP Connectivity with details=HTTP/2 connection successful and status=pass.
The log shows component=Cloudflare API with details=API is reachable and status=pass.
The log shows precheck complete with hard_fail=false and suggested_protocol=quic.
The log records CurveID(65074) with connection preference output and a Cloudflare edge IP.
A Registered tunnel connection entry is visible with location=del02 and protocol=quic.
The log shows Updated to new configuration, including ingress for hostname mcp.gpsrginfo.in to service http://127.0.0.1:8787 and a fallback http_status:404.
A second Registered tunnel connection is visible with location=del03 and protocol=quic.
A third Registered tunnel connection is visible with location=del02 and protocol=quic.
A fourth Registered tunnel connection is visible with location=del03 and protocol=quic.

The screenshot proves successful tunnel prechecks, four registered QUIC connections, and the pushed ingress configuration. It does not by itself prove that the local MCP service on 127.0.0.1:8787 was healthy at that exact moment or that an external /health request succeeded.

findings.finding: Tunnel connectivity is proven, but origin application health is not proven by this screenshot alone.
findings.correction: Verify local http://127.0.0.1:8787/health and externally verify https://mcp.gpsrginfo.in/health.

findings.finding: The screenshot shows ingress configuration but not a successful request flowing through the ingress to the MCP service.
findings.correction: Perform one end-to-end request and inspect the returned JSON/application status.

findings.finding: The visible log is historical evidence dated 2026-10-01, not proof of current 2026-10-07 runtime state.
findings.correction: Use fresh tunnel logs when making a current-state claim.

next_correction_priority: verify one MCP request through the public endpoint
use fresh logs before claiming current tunnel state
